children: shares jumped 45% after Copart agreed to buy the digital vehicle auction company for $10.50 per share in cash, valuing its equity at about $1.9 billion.
The proposed price is about 45% above ACV Auctions' unaffected Aug. 10 closing price and represents a 41% premium to its 30-day volume-weighted average price through Sept. 9.

Copart (CPRT) plans to finance the transaction using available cash. The acquisition has received unanimous approval from the boards of both companies and is targeted for completion by the end of 2026, pending customary closing requirements, including antitrust review.

The transaction is expected to have no impact on Copart's earnings per share during the first full fiscal year after completion. Management expects the deal to add to earnings per share beginning in fiscal 2028 and afterward.

Copart shares climbed 7% following the deal announcement. The transaction gives Copart access to ACV Auctions' digital dealer auction platform as it expands its operations in the vehicle remarketing market.

title: ACV Auctions Stock Explodes After Copart's $1.9 Billion Takeover
